g.text: P1: learned accuracy remains behind Lawson 2 at similar observed action cost

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #444444

g.text: Timing subset: first diagnostic parent of each family · 24 contexts · five randomized paired rounds · CPU, one numerical thread
Small points: individual contexts. Diamonds: RMS pooled across these 24 contexts; median of their five-round median times.
Every source rebuilds path/features; no setup reuse. Offline reference/fitting cost is separate. Cold/warmup calls are excluded.
The uncertainty line is pooled; context-specific uncertainties differ. These empirical estimates are not certificates.
Comparisons near their reference-uncertainty scale are unresolved. No matched-tolerance speedup is established.
